Hi Rachel,

We're approaching our March renewal and want to lock in a plan today. We have two needs that are tied to the renewal: a) carve out a sequestered Private environment for our PHI workloads (data residency + stricter access controls) and b) increase baseline capacity by ~35% to cover forecasted growth and a new inference-heavy analytics pipeline.

High-level asks:
- Target go-live for the isolated environment: Nov 1, 2026.
- Baseline capacity increase: +35% GPU vCPU / token throughput; ability to burst to +60% for three 8-12 hour windows per month.
- Contract term: 24 months preferred, but open to discussion on term-linked pricing.
- We need an initial MAP (mutual action plan) + a ballpark SOW and cost delta for budgeting.

Can you confirm feasibility and a rough timeline (technical & procurement) so we can brief our executive and legal teams? We'll loop procurement and legal as needed.

Thanks,

Quick technical notes for the MAP and SOW draft:
- Sequester approach: provision a dedicated VPC with customer-controlled KMS and restricted peering. We'll enforce tenant-level ACLs and audit logs forwarded to the customer's SIEM.
- Topology: recommending a 3-node Dedicated control plane + 6 inference nodes (NVIDIA A40 equivalent) to meet the +35% baseline; add 2 spare nodes for burst windows.
- Time estimates: provisioning + security config ~3–4 weeks (assuming network approvals), hardening + compliance review 2 weeks, pilot testing 2 weeks. Total path to pilot ~7–8 weeks.
- Risks: network IP whitelisting and legal review of our support access model (jumpbox/HSM access) can add 1–2 weeks.

I'll include a short appendix in the SOW that spells out the autoscale/burst conditions and rollback triggers.
